rows: Here is the deal. I hit hard, and I do not pretend otherwise.
You want noise? I can make noise.
The people came for a scrap. They are getting one.
I have been training to hit harder, and I am.
Look at me. I am not moving.
You talk technique. Show me the strike.
A risk is a punch you throw. Take it.
A stall is a waste of the scrap.
The people want a fight. Here is one.
You say you are good. Prove it in the scrap.
You are proud of your strength. Good. Hit me with it.
I want to see your strength hit something.
You kept calm. Good, but I am not calm.
I could talk. I would rather hit.
One fall. Keep me down if you can.
On the mat, I push. You push back.
Grounded or standing, I still throw.
Stay in front of me and take it.
Good answer. Now back it up.
You have not answered. Answer with your hands.
I accept that. Bell and fight.
I will fight this match with everything I have.
My approach is simple. I hit and I keep hitting.
Whatever happens, I will keep fighting.
It is not finished. Next round is coming.
I have one more punch. You will feel it when the bell rings.
